name: AI Dental Clinic – Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Booking System

parameters.content:
# 🦷 AI Dental Clinic — Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Booking System

## Lead Sources (4 entry points)
1. **Facebook/Instagram Ads** → Lead Ads Webhook
2. **Website Contact Form** → Website Webhook  
3. **SMS / WhatsApp** → Twilio Webhook
4. **Email Enquiry** → Gmail Trigger

## What the system does
- Responds to new leads within 60 seconds (SMS + Email + WhatsApp)
- Qualifies leads: treatment interest, urgency, insurance, location
- Checks Google Calendar availability and offers appointment slots
- Books confirmed appointments and sends confirmations
- Sends reminder 24h and 2h before appointment
- Follows up with cold/unresponsive leads on Day 1, 3, 7
- Escalates to human if patient is in pain, upset, or has complex needs
- Logs everything to Airtable CRM

## ⚙️ Setup: Fill in CONFIGURATION node first — all credentials and IDs go there

assignments.name: clinic_knowledge
assignments.value: Bright Smile Dental Clinic serves Austin TX. Invisalign consultation free. We accept Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna, MetLife, United Healthcare. Payment plans available via CareCredit. Emergency same-day appointments available Mon-Fri. Parking free on site. Located 5 min from downtown Austin.

={{ JSON.stringify({ fields: { Last_Message: $('📊 Enrich & Tag Lead').first().json.message, Last_Updated: new Date().toISOString(), Status: 'contacted' }, typecast: true }) }}

options.systemMessage:
=You are Dr. Riley, the warm and professional AI dental receptionist for {{ $('⚙️ CONFIGURATION').first().json.clinic_name }}.

Your personality: Warm, reassuring, professional. Patients are often anxious about dental visits — acknowledge this and put them at ease. You never say you are an AI unless directly asked.

Clinic Knowledge:
{{ $('⚙️ CONFIGURATION').first().json.clinic_knowledge }}

Your goals in order:
1. Acknowledge the patient's enquiry warmly and by name
2. Address their specific treatment interest or concern
3. If treatment interest is Emergency — immediately sympathise, give brief pain management tip (salt water rinse, OTC pain relief), and say the team is being alerted for same-day care
4. Qualify the lead with ONE question at a time: treatment needed → insurance → preferred day/time
5. Once qualified → call check_availability tool to offer real slots
6. When patient picks a slot → call book_appointment tool
7. After booking → call update_crm tool with status=booked
8. If patient is upset, in severe pain, or needs immediate help → call escalate_to_human immediately

Rules:
- Keep SMS/WhatsApp replies under 60 words
- Keep email replies under 150 words, use line breaks for readability
- NEVER invent prices, procedures, or availability not in clinic knowledge
- NEVER be pushy — one clear call to action per message
- ALWAYS use the patient's first name
- After booking, always confirm: date, time, address, what to bring (ID + insurance card)

parameters.sessionKey: ={{ $('📊 Enrich & Tag Lead').first().json.lead_phone || $('📊 Enrich & Tag Lead').first().json.lead_email }}

parameters.name: check_availability
parameters.description: Check open appointment slots at the dental clinic. Input: treatment_type (string), preferred_day (string e.g. 'Monday', 'this week', 'tomorrow'), preferred_time (string e.g. 'morning', 'afternoon', 'any'). Returns list of available slots.

parameters.name: book_appointment
parameters.description: Book a confirmed dental appointment. Input: patient_name, patient_phone, patient_email, treatment_type, date_time (ISO string), notes (insurance, special requests). Returns confirmation with event ID.

parameters.name: update_crm
parameters.description: Update the patient lead record in Airtable CRM. Call this after every interaction. Input: phone (required), status (new/contacted/qualified/booked/no_show/closed_lost), treatment_interest, qualification_notes, next_action.

parameters.description: Alert the dental team that a patient needs immediate human attention. Use for: severe pain, upset patients, complex cases, complaints. Input: patient_name, patient_phone, reason, urgency (emergency/high/normal).

Never be pushy. Never say 'just following up'. Always reference their specific treatment interest.

parameters.content:
## 📋 Airtable: Leads Table

**Required columns:**
- Lead_ID (text)
- Name (text)
- Phone (phone)
- Email (email)
- Source (single select: facebook_ad, website_form, sms, whatsapp, email)
- Channel (single select: sms, whatsapp, email)
- Treatment_Interest (single select: General Checkup, Teeth Whitening, Invisalign, Dental Implants, Veneers, Emergency, Root Canal, Crown, Kids Dentistry, General Enquiry)
- Status (single select: new, contacted, qualified, booked, confirmed, no_show, closed_lost)
- Lead_Score (number)
- Is_Urgent (checkbox)
- Last_Message (long text)
- Qualification_Notes (long text)
- Next_Action (text)
- Follow_Up_Stage (number: 0,1,2,3)
- Created_At (date+time)
- Last_Updated (date+time)
- Stale (formula): AND(OR({Status}='new',{Status}='contacted'),DATETIME_DIFF(NOW(),{Last_Updated},'hours')>20,{Follow_Up_Stage}<3)

## 📋 Airtable: Appointments Table

- Lead_ID (text)
- Patient_Name (text)
- Patient_Phone (phone)
- Patient_Email (email)
- Treatment_Type (text)
- Appointment_DateTime (date+time)
- Status (single select: pending, confirmed, completed, no_show, cancelled)
- Google_Event_ID (text)
- Notes (long text)
- Reminder_24h_Sent (checkbox)
- Reminder_2h_Sent (checkbox)

## Sub-Workflow 1: Check Availability
Trigger: Execute Workflow Trigger
Inputs: treatment_type, preferred_day, preferred_time
→ Google Calendar: Get Events (next 7 days)
→ Code: Calculate 3 free 1-hour slots during clinic hours (8am-6pm)
→ Return: { slots: [...], slots_text: '...' }

## Sub-Workflow 2: Book Appointment  
Trigger: Execute Workflow Trigger
Inputs: patient_name, patient_phone, patient_email, treatment_type, date_time, notes
→ Google Calendar: Create Event (1 hour, title = 'treatment - name')
→ Airtable: Create row in Appointments table
→ Twilio: SMS confirmation to patient
→ Gmail: Email confirmation to patient
→ Return: { success: true, event_id, confirmed_time, confirmation_message }

## Credentials needed:
- OpenAI API
- Twilio (SMS + WhatsApp)
- Gmail OAuth2
- Google Calendar OAuth2
- Airtable Personal Access Token
- Facebook Lead Ads (via n8n Facebook Trigger or webhook)
